    "781c3dec: ;\n ;\n ;\n ;\n ;This routine is used to edit the Attending Physician field (#.1)\n ;in the Medical Student File (#393). It also edits the Student's\n ;Physician Preceptor fields (#3 and #5).",
    "159bedca: ;Validate and process the user's response.",
    "59434c43: ;Initialize variables for the INPUT transform.",
    "b7e2ab0a: ;If the .01 field is defined, set DE(1) to the value.",
    "91919228: ;Kill scratch nodes.",
    "fbffe670: ;Write the line label.",
    "7c29fd1b: ;Quit if the field is not to be edited.",
    "cbe7919a: ;Write the data and perform line wrap.",
    "7d6fbeb2: ;If data is longer than 19 characters, perform word-wrapping.",
    "5bdaec7c: ;If the INPUT transform indicates no editing allowed, display a message.",
    "1ca3b2f0: ;Read user's response and handle timeout.",
    "35bf903a: ;Quit if the field is not to be edited.",
    "08bd12a9: ;Increment the DQ counter for the next question.",
    "9946587b: ;Branch to the appropriate DQ code.",
    "0d01a48a: ;If a transform routine is present, execute it.",
    "50895619: ;If X is null, go to A if DV doesn't contain 'R', or go to X if DV doesn't exist, or go to X if D is less than or equal to 0, or go to A.",
    "daa3181c: ;If X starts with '?', go to QS. If X starts with '^', call D and go to ^DIE17.",
    "51c48cc8: ;If X is '@', call D and go to Z^DIE2.",
    "e02abbba: ;If X is a space, DV contains 'd', DV doesn't contain 'P', and the user's default value for DLB exists, set X to the default value. If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write the value.",
    "8cd49484: ;If DV exists, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P. Call ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) if it exists. Set % to the value after ';' and X. If % isn't null, call DIC('S') if it exists. If it doesn't write '  '%. Go to V.",
    "cc920a0e: ;Loop through DU, splitting on ';'. Set DG to the position of X in the current piece (Y). If DG is true, call DIC('S') if it exists. Quit if DG is true.",
    "4a143940: ;If DB(DQ) doesn't exist, write the substring of YS starting from DG. Set X to the piece of YS before ':'.",
    "2d1482a3: ;If DV contains 'P', set DIC to U_DU, and set DIC(0) based on DB(DQ) and whether DV contains \"'\". If DIC(0) contains 'L', set DLAYGO to the second piece of DV after 'P'. If DV doesn't contain '*', call ^DIC. Set X to +Y. Set DIC to DIE. Go to X if X is less than 0.",
    "b1cf57a0: ;If DV doesn't contain 'N', call D. If the length of the piece of X after '.' is greater than 24, kill X and go to Z.",
    "5f2a69d2: ;If the second piece of DV after ',' exists, X contains '.', and the fifth piece of DQ(DQ) doesn't contain '$', set X based on conditions involving removing leading/trailing 0s and '00'. If X ends with '.', convert X to a number.",
    "970d3e41: ;Call X_DQ. Kill YS.",
    "4f8eaffa: ;Kill DIC('S') and DLAYGO. If X exists and isn't null, set DG(DW) to X. If DV contains 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,'DIE',DLB) to X. Go to A.",
    "57425930: ;Write '*7' and '??'. If DB(DQ) exists, go to Z^DIE17.",
    "e207765c: ;Set X to '?BAD'.",
    "09f073d4: ;Set DZ to X. Call D and QQ^DIEQ. Go to B.",
    "8669272d: ;D is set to the field number (DIFLD), and DQ(DQ) is set to the field label (DLB), data type (DV), input transform (DU), word processing fld # (DW) and the executable code for the X? cross reference.",
    "07728907: ;If no data is present in ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12), go to RD label if X='@', go to label A if DV doesn't allow REPLACE and X='@', or go to label X if X='@'. Otherwise set X=Y and go to label N.",
    "796f790f: ;If data exists in ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12), set DG=DV, Y=^DD(DP,DIFLD,12) data, X=DU. If DQ(DQ,2) data exists, execute code in DQ(DQ,2). Otherwise go to RP label.",
    "57bae196: ;If DG is a pointer, and the pointed-to file's 0 node exists, set X to the .01 field of the pointed-to entry. If DG is not a pointer or the pointed-to 0 node doesn't exist, go to RP.",
    "f4ea3da3: ;If DG is a variable pointer, Y is numeric, the 2nd ; piece of Y contains '(', and the global node described by that piece exists, set X to the .01 field of the entry to which it points. If that global node doesn't exist, go to RP. If the .01 field has a specifier code, set DG and X from that code and go to R label.",
    "00148e4c: ;If DG is a MUMPS X column, execute code in X routine (^DD(\"DD\")). If DG is a string, set Y to 2nd ; piece of DU;X, with ; as 1st piece delimiter.",
    "1fff5af9: ;Write field prompt. If X is null, set X=DE(DQ). If not REPLACING or user\ub533 not allowed a 2nd REPLACE attempt, go to A. Else go to N^DIE17.",
    "80424bae: ;If DV is not INPUT transform and not COMPUTED-FIELD, go to RD.",
    "a963509c: ;Execute INPUT transform (E^DIE0). If transform sets X, go to RD, else go to PR.",
    "228c8d57: ;End of DIE.",
    "35e380ff: ;Entry point for INIT. Set DNM (option name), DQ (level of nested DQ calls).",
    "3df5161d: ;Process field .1: Set DW (word processing #), DV (DATA TYPE), DU (null), DLB (FIELD LABEL), DIFLD (field #).",
    "22ec9360: ;Set DU to pointer file # and global root for File 200.",
    "e97fd7a5: ;Branch to field's RE (reader) code.",
    "47a96b3e: ;End of code for field .1.",
    "e21ec4b8: ;\n .;Jump 3: If this field has been edited, call the FileMan input transform\n .;and then (if the result is not null and not '^') set X to the result, set\n .;the DIC(0) and DW parameters for EN^DIE17, and call OUT^DIE17 to update the\n .;database.",
    "d6d88d16: ;Jump 3 AUDIT: If this is not a DIAGNOSIS transaction, set Y=@BLANK@",
    "46b277ca: ;Jump 3 AUDIT: Kill Y (return null)",
    "d4ea7ffc: ;Jump 4\n .;This jump is skipped - it falls through to jump 5",
    "aec65f54: ;\n .;Jump 5: If this field has been edited, call the FileMan input transform\n .;and then (if the result is not null and not '^') set X to the result, set\n .;the DIC(0) and DW parameters for EN^DIE17, and call OUT^DIE17 to update the\n .;database.",
    "cda085e3: ;Jump 5 AUDIT: If this is not a DIAGNOSIS transaction, set Y=@BLANK@",
    "8817505c: ;Jump 5 AUDIT: Kill Y (return null)",
    "ed5a399e: ;Field .07 jumps directly to DGJXE9",
    "e928ae99: ;Jump 6: If field has been edited, call FileMan input transform"
  ]
}
